name: br_ui
description: NUI for Blitz Royale. Builds into resources/[fivem-royale]/br_ui/ui, and the Season 2 terminal app into resources/[computer]/cuchi_computer/nui/apps/terminal.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run check:css && npm run check:ui && npm run test:envelope && npm run test:countdown && npm run test:impacts && npm run test:placement && npm run test:cardplacement && npm run test:chatclear && npm run test:music && npm run test:continuetoggle && npm run test:tutoriallock && npm run test:tutorialgame && npm run test:fade && npm run test:cold && npm run test:lockerv2 && npm run test:marketv2 && npm run test:fit && npm run check:layout && npm run test:lockerv2menus && npm run build:terminal && node scripts/check-css.mjs pages && npm run test:cef && npm run check:cef
scripts.build:terminal: vite build -c vite.terminal.config.ts && node scripts/check-css.mjs terminal && node scripts/check-terminal.mjs && node scripts/test-terminal-model.mjs && node scripts/test-terminal-desktop.mjs

//: Pinned to the HeroUI 2.x line and Tailwind 3.x deliberately. FiveM's CEF is Chrome 103, which cannot parse oklch/oklab/lch/color-mix -- and HeroUI 3 + Tailwind 4 emit those throughout their colour systems. scripts/check-css.mjs fails the build if any reach the bundle.
//browserslist: autoprefixer's target. Its defaults alone no longer reach Chrome 103, so the prefixes 103 needs (mask-image) were there by luck; naming 103 makes them certain. Kept with the defaults so the shipped CSS is unchanged. Chrome 103 until every client is on CEF 144 (#413, docs/platform.md).
